name: cogno-soma
summary: The reference orchestrator for the Cogno cognitive pipeline — wires cogno-anima's stages (NOUMENO→NER→ID→EGO⇄SUPEREGO→Drift) end-to-end with the correction loop, PII/scope/handoff gates, an interception seam and atomicity hooks. Infra-agnostic: the host injects backends, the dispatcher and prompts.
author: Vinicius Vale
